description: A black lace-up shoe sits on a light green bedspread, with the loose laces lying on top. The left hand and right hand move in toward the shoe and pinch the lace ends, pulling them outward to undo a partial knot, then bring the laces back together and pull them outward again to tighten and re-form the tie, alternating between a two-hand object on the laces and brief releases.
